Given below is the plot of a potential energy function U(x) for a system, in which a particle is in one dimensional motion, while a conservative force F(x) acts on it. Suppose that Emech = 8 J, the incorrect statement for this system is :


[ where K.E. = kinetic energy ]

options.content: at x > x<sub>4</sub> K.E. is constant throughout the region.
at x < x<sub>1</sub>, K.E. is smallest and the particle is moving at the slowest speed.
at x = x<sub>2</sub>, K.E. is greatest and the particle is moving at the fastest speed.
at x = x<sub>3</sub>, K.E. = 4 J.

en.explanation:
Emech. = 8J

(A) at x > x4

U = constant = 6J

K = Emech. U = 2J = constant

(B) at x < x1

U = constant = 8J

K = Emech U = 8 8 - 0 J

Particle is at rest.

(C) At x = x2,

U = 0 Emech. = K = 8 J

KE is greatest, and particle is moving at fastest speed.

(D) At x = x3

U = 4J

U + K = 8J

K = 4J
